summary: @servicetitan/datadog-rum preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun standalone runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB obfuscator.io-style Bun-CJS bundle (hex `_0x` identifiers, string-array rotator, numeric lookup table) whose name is unrelated to the package's advertised Datadog RUM (browser telemetry) purpose. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is listed in `package.json`'s `files` array (declared as `["dist", "src"]`), but both are shipped at the tarball root, and preinstall bypasses the `files` restriction. Installing the package with default npm settings causes an alien runtime to execute an opaque obfuscated payload on the installer's machine — an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that also evades Node-based static analysis. The behavior has no relationship to the package's stated function as a Datadog RUM SDK wrapper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
